description: A class of nonempty first-order structures is finitely axiomatizable if and only if both it and its complement, taken among the nonempty structures in the same language, are axiomatizable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.finite_axiomatizability_iff_complement.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (C : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.StructureClass L) :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.IsFinitelyAxiomatizable C ↔
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.IsAxiomatizable C ∧ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.IsAxiomatizable Cᶜ
